transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what’s been bringing you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Um, thank you for seeing me. I hope I'm in the right place... I, well, I came in mostly because my husband asked me to. He and some of the folks at the warehouse where I work, they've been acting like I'm... well, like I'm not making sense lately. But I just—I'm just trying to do my job, you know? 

It's just that I've noticed things. I know they've been watching my moves on the floor, and... and changing the pallet counts on my shift. I think they're doing it to keep me from getting the supervisor spot that opened up. I mean, that makes sense, right? It's not crazy to think people get competitive at work, is it? I just want to make sure I'm explaining this okay... I don't want to sound like a problem employee or anything.
Have you ever noticed or experienced things that others around you don't seem to notice—like hearing voices or seeing things that aren't there?

Um... well, I really don't want you to think I'm losing my mind or anything. I know how that kind of thing sounds, and I don't want to seem like I belong in a hospital. It's probably just stress, right? 

But... I guess sometimes I do hear something. It's not a big deal, I promise. Just, um, sometimes when I'm in the aisle at the warehouse, or even just at home folding clothes, I'll hear a man's voice. It sounds clear as day, just telling me, Nicole, check it again. And... well, nobody is anywhere near me when it happens. 

But it's probably just my brain trying to make sure I don't make mistakes at work, you know? Because I really care about doing a good job and getting that supervisor spot. That's a normal thing to happen when you're working really hard and get tired, isn't it? I hope that doesn't make me sound bad.
Do you believe that your coworkers are deliberately changing the pallet counts on your shift even though there may be no proof or evidence that this is actually happening?

Um... well, I guess I don't have, like, a video recording or actual paperwork to show HR. So, no, I don't have hard proof. But I just... I just know they are doing it. 

My husband and the other warehouse people, they keep acting like I'm crazy for saying it, which is why he wanted me to come here. But I know what I see. I know they've been watching my every move and messing with the pallet counts to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. 

I really hope I don't sound paranoid saying that out loud to you. I'm not a troublemaker, I promise, and I don't want to accuse people of things unfairly. I just want a fair shot at the promotion, and it's hard when you know people are working against you. That... that makes sense, doesn't it? It's a normal thing to be upset about, right?
Do you believe, despite others telling you otherwise, that your coworkers are definitely working against you even without any clear proof?

Um... yes, I guess I do. I mean, I know my husband and everyone at the warehouse keep telling me I'm wrong, and they act like I'm... well, like I'm just making it all up. And I know I don't have, like, a piece of paper to prove it to you. 

But I just... I know it's happening. I know they're watching me out there on the floor, and I know they're messing with the pallet counts. It's the only thing that makes sense if they want to stop me from getting that supervisor spot. 

I'm really sorry if that sounds bad, or if it makes me seem like I'm difficult to work with. I'm really not, I try so hard to be a good employee. It's just hard when you know something is going on, even if other people don't see it. Do you... do you think it's okay for me to feel that way? I just don't want you to think I'm crazy like they do.
Can you tell me if these beliefs about your coworkers trying to keep you from getting the supervisor position have been happening consistently over a long period of time, like months or even longer?

Um... well, I don't want you to think I've been like this forever. I'm usually a really normal, focused person, I promise. I've always been a hard worker. 

But... I guess, if I'm being completely honest... the voice I mentioned, and that feeling that people are watching me or changing my numbers... it's been happening for about eight months now. I really tried to just push through it and do my job at first, because I didn't want to be a bother to anyone or make a big fuss. 

Eight months isn't too terribly long to be dealing with something like this, is it? I just really hope that doesn't make me sound like a bad employee... or like I'm too far gone to be helped. That's not too long of a time, right? I can still get back on track?
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or felt like your thoughts were racing more than usual?

Um... well, I guess there are times when I feel... really productive? Like, I don't want it to sound like I'm manic or anything bad, I just... I get these bursts where I'm just really on top of things. 

Like, sometimes I'll finish a full shift at the warehouse, and instead of being tired like most people, I just... I get so much energy in my body. I'll come home and go box for a while, and then I'll clean the whole kitchen, and then I'll start making all these lists for the next day. And I just don't even feel ready to sit down yet. 

I mean, being energetic and getting things done is a good thing, right? Employers like that. I just... I guess my thoughts do go a little fast when I'm like that, and maybe I don't sleep as much, but I'm still getting everything done. That's not a bad thing to be a hard worker, is it? I just want to make sure you know I'm still being productive when that happens.
Have you ever had times when your mood was really high, like you felt extremely happy or irritable for several days in a row, even if you were still getting things done?

Um... well, I really try to stay positive, I do. Mostly I just feel really... fired up? Like nobody can slow me down. Which is a good thing for getting things done, right? 

But... I guess, if I'm being totally honest... sometimes when I'm going like that for a few days, I can get a little bit... edgy. Like, my husband will just ask one small question about the kids, or ask about my schedule, and I just... I kind of snap at him. I really don't mean to be mean! It just feels in that moment like he's trying to control me or slow me down when I'm finally doing so well. 

I always feel terrible about it later, because I really do try to be a good wife and a good mother. I don't want you to think I'm an angry person. That's just normal stress from having a lot on my plate, isn't it? Everyone gets a little irritable sometimes when they're just trying to keep everything moving, right?
Have you noticed any problems in your ability to function at work or at home, like trouble focusing, completing tasks, or getting along with others, that are new or worse than before?

Um... well, I really try my best to do a good job everywhere. I always want to be helpful, you know? But... I guess things have been a little bit harder lately. 

Like at work, I'm usually really good at my job, I promise. But lately, my supervisors... they took me off the forklift and some of the other safety stuff. They said my counts were off and my routines were kind of... slowing the line down. I really didn't mean to cause any trouble for anyone. I just get so distracted sometimes with everything going on in my head. They're just being careful, right? That's what good supervisors do. 

And at home... well, I try so hard to be a good wife and mom. But my husband... he told me recently that he feels like he can't rely on me the way he used to. That really hurt to hear, because I want to be someone he can count on. I just... I get so overwhelmed sometimes, and things slip my mind. That doesn't make me a bad person, does it? I'm still trying my best... that counts for something, right?

Have you ever experienced any strange or unusual thoughts or perceptions that other people around you don’t seem to share—like believing you have special powers, a special mission, or that you’re receiving special messages from outside sources?

Um... well, I really don't want to sound like I'm... like I'm crazy or anything. I know that's why my husband wanted me to come talk to you, and I guess my supervisors at the warehouse think so too, but... I just... I try to get along with everyone, I really do. 

But... I guess... well, I know they've been watching me. The warehouse people, I mean. I know it sounds strange when I say it out loud, but I've been doing such a good job, and... and I know they've been changing the pallet counts on me. Like, on purpose. Just to make me look bad so I don't get that supervisor spot I've been working so hard for. 

I don't have special powers or anything like that, I promise! I just... I pay attention to things. And I can see what they're doing. It's not crazy to notice when people are trying to hold you back at work, is it? I mean, office politics happen everywhere, right? I just want to do my job well, and it feels like they're trying to stop me. That's a normal thing to be upset about, isn't it?
Can you tell me if you've ever believed something strongly that others around you didn’t believe, even though you didn’t have proof and people tried to tell you otherwise?

Um... well, like I was saying before... I really don't think it's anything like a, you know, a crazy belief. I just... I know what I'm seeing. 

I know my husband thinks I'm making it up, and that's why he pushed so hard for me to come see you. And I guess the warehouse managers think I'm just making excuses because my counts have been off. I really hate that they think that about me, because I try so hard to be honest and do a good job. 

But... I just know they're watching my moves at work. I don't have proof on paper or anything, but I can just tell. They're changing the pallet counts when I'm not looking. And I know people say I'm just stressed, or that I'm overthinking it, but... I really believe they're doing it on purpose so I don't get that supervisor spot. 

I mean, it's not unusual to feel like people are playing favorites or trying to keep you down at work, right? That's a normal thing to be worried about. I'm not trying to cause trouble by saying it... I just want things to be fair. That makes sense, doesn't it?
Have you ever believed something very strongly that other people didn’t believe, even when there was no proof and people tried to tell you otherwise?

Um... I know we just talked about this a little bit, and I really hope I'm answering your questions the right way. I don't want to sound like a broken record or anything... I'm trying to be helpful, I promise. 

It's just like I said... the whole reason I came in is because my husband and the warehouse people keep acting like I'm crazy. But I just know they've been watching my moves and changing the pallet counts to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. 

I know they don't believe me, and they tell me I'm wrong... but I just feel it so strongly, you know? It's not a bad thing to trust your gut, is it? I just want to do a good job and be treated fairly. I hope you can understand where I'm coming from... I'm not trying to be difficult, really.
Have you ever believed something so strongly that you felt certain it was true, even when there was no evidence to support it and everyone else told you it wasn't real?

Oh, gosh... I'm so sorry, I feel like I'm frustrating you because you're having to ask me the same kind of question again. I really don't mean to give the wrong answer, I promise. Did I explain it badly before? 

I just... I don't really have anything else besides what I've been telling you. The whole reason I even came in today is because my husband and all the warehouse people keep acting like I'm crazy about this whole thing. They all tell me it's not real, just like you said, and that I don't have any hard evidence. But... even with everyone telling me I'm wrong, I just know they've been watching my moves on the floor. I know for a fact they're changing those pallet counts to keep me away from that supervisor spot. 

I'm sorry, I know I keep repeating myself. I really am trying to answer the way you need me to... is that the kind of thing you're asking about? Am I doing okay?
Have you ever believed that you had a special role, unique mission, or abilities that other people don’t have?

Oh, um... no, definitely not. I don't think I'm special or have any kind of powers or anything like that. I'm just a normal person trying to do my job, you know? 

I really wouldn't want anyone to think I had a big ego or thought I was better than everyone else. I just want to work hard and get treated fairly. That's a good thing, right? To just want to be normal and do things the right way? I hope I'm making sense... I definitely don't have any kind of special mission or anything weird like that.
Have you ever experienced any beliefs or thoughts that made it hard for you to trust people, caused problems at work, or affected your relationships, even if they seemed real to you at the time?

Um... well... I hope you don't think I'm a bad worker or a bad wife or anything. I really try my best, I promise. But... I guess things have been a little hard lately. 

At work, my supervisors took me off the forklift and some of the other safety stuff. They said my counts and the way I was doing my routines were slowing the line down. I really didn't mean to cause any trouble, I just wanted to make sure everything was right because of... well, you know, what I was telling you about before. I hope that makes sense. I'm still working hard, just doing different tasks now. 

And at home... my husband told me he feels like he can't rely on me the way he used to. That really hurt to hear, because I want to be a good partner to him. I don't want to be a burden. I'm trying to fix it, I really am. Do you think things like that happen to a lot of people? I just want to get back to being the person they need me to be.

Have you ever had a strong belief that something was happening—like people plotting against you or secretly changing things at work—that felt completely real to you, even though it wasn’t based on any clear proof?

Oh, um... I feel so bad because I know we just talked about this, and I really, really don't want to sound like a broken record or make you think I'm not listening to you. I promise I am. 

But... yes, that's exactly what I've been trying to say. I hope it doesn't make me sound like a terrible person or super paranoid, because I'm normally very easygoing. It's just... I know they've been watching my moves on the floor, and I know they're changing the pallet counts so I don't get that supervisor spot. My husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I'm crazy for thinking it, and they say there's no proof, but... I just know it's happening. 

I'm so sorry, I know that's basically what I told you a minute ago. I'm just trying to be honest with you because I really want to do this right. Is it okay that I said the same thing again? I'm answering the question right, aren't I?
Have you ever felt like people outside of work, like neighbors or strangers, were also acting against you or changing things in your life without your knowledge?

Oh, um... no, no, definitely not. I really hope you don't think I'm the kind of person who just thinks everyone is out to get them everywhere they go. I'm really not like that, I promise. 

My neighbors are perfectly nice, and strangers are just... strangers, you know? I don't have any problems with anyone outside of work. I try to be friendly and polite to everyone I meet. I'd hate for you to think I'm causing trouble in my neighborhood or anything. It's really just that specific situation at the warehouse. 

I just want to be a good neighbor and a normal person. That's normal, right? To just have issues at work sometimes but be fine everywhere else? I hope I'm giving you the right answers. I really don't want you to think I'm making things up or being difficult.
Have you ever felt like people you don’t know well, like strangers or people you see around town, were sending you secret messages or acting in a way that was specifically directed at you?

Oh, gosh... no. No, definitely not. I really hope you don't think I'm, like, totally losing my mind or anything. I promise I don't see secret messages or think people on the street are doing things just for me. 

I just... I just go to the store, get my groceries, and go straight home. I try really hard to mind my own business and just be a regular person. I wouldn't want to bother anybody out in public. I'm not that far gone, I promise. I'm just trying to get by and do the right thing. 

Is... is that what you were looking for? I just want to make sure I'm being helpful and answering your questions right. You believe me, right?
Have you ever believed that something about you was very important, special, or part of a bigger plan that other people didn’t seem to understand?

Oh, um... no. No, I don't think I'm special or part of any big plan or anything like that. I really, really don't want to come across like I have a big ego or think I'm better than anyone else. I'm just a regular person trying to do my job at the warehouse. 

I know I don't have a fancy degree or anything, so I'd never pretend to be some important person. I just want to do my work, go home to my husband, and live a quiet life. I promise I don't have any grand ideas about myself. 

I hope that's an okay answer? I just want you to know I'm very grounded and realistic about who I am. You don't think I'm arrogant, do you?
